summary.text: Devin LeMahieu is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 9, based in Oostburg, and has been elected to the Senate since 2014.
He chairs the Committee on Senate Organization and has held the Majority Leader position.

paragraphs.text: LeMahieu was born in Sheboygan, Wisconsin, on August 8, 1972, and is married.
He graduated from Sheboygan County Christian High School in 1991 and earned a B.A. in business administration and political science from Dordt College in Sioux Center, Iowa, in 1995.
He is the publisher and owner of Lakeshore Weekly.
The Legislature's page lists him as an elected Sheboygan County Board supervisor from 2006 to 2015.
He was elected to the Senate in 2014 and has held the Majority Leader position in 2021 and 2023.
His listed memberships include the Oostburg, Sheboygan County and Manitowoc County chambers of commerce and the National Rifle Association as a life member.
